{{Youmay|the weapon|[[Rocket darts|the game]]}}
[[File:Lethal_Trackdown_-_Rocket_Darts.png|thumb|A pair of rocket darts]]

A '''rocket dart''' was a type of projectile weapon. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] had a [[Boot/Legends|boot]] equipped with two rocket darts. Sing attempted to kill [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] with these darts when the two were part of a [[Second mission to Florrum/Legends|standoff]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. Koon dodged the darts, however.
